lines.text: Many learners say: I entered the bath last night.
Better: I took a bath last night.
Took! I took a bath last night.

native.tip: 「お風呂に入る」は take a bath。enter は使いません。
native.caption: “I entered the bath last night.”と言っていませんか？😅 「入る」を enter で訳してしまいがちです。“I took a bath last night.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“took”。“I took a bath last night.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “I entered the bath last night.” 😅 The Japanese 入る does not match enter here. The natural way is “I took a bath last night.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
